description: The data of a document-grant.changed event: a document grant was issued or revoked.

actorKind.description: The kind of caller that issued or revoked the grant.

change.description: Whether the grant was issued or revoked.

documentId.description: The document the event is about.

expiresAt.description: The expiry frozen into the grant at issue. Reaching it emits no event: the grant stops releasing the version at this instant.

policyId.description: The document policy the document is held under.

policyVersion.description: The version of that policy the document was placed under.

versionDigest.description: The SHA-256 digest of the version's content.

versionId.description: The exact document version the event is about.

title: Registry Stack Document Store document-grant.changed event data
